TRIP STYLE

Surf & pier

Fish from the beach, rocks or a pier. Access, casting space and surf conditions set the limits.

Find this style on the atlas ↗

Who it suits

Anglers who prefer a shore-based day and can adapt to local access conditions.

Boats & gear

Shore tackle, a suitable landing method and secure footwear matter. Confirm the cast, current and allowed access before choosing weights.

Seasons

Ask how tides, swell and local fish movements affect the proposed date.
